pairs.subject: supply-chain
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/scripts/dev-source-loc.mjs:54 The dev server pulls @babel/core into a build-time plugin that runs on the developer workstation. No hand-kept build-time dependency inventory exists anywhere in the repo (git grep for build-time dependency/tier/inventory terms found nothing), so this tier is still priced by the merged graph. The env-var gate narrows when the plugin runs, but it does not inventory the dependency.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs:25 Turns on the app ACL manifest, so each command reaches only the webviews a per-surface capability grants it to. Page webviews get only bridge_reply. The header (build.rs:15) says commands.test.ts holds the declared, registered, permitted and invoked lists in parity, and that test asserts a nonzero population.

apps/desktop/scripts/dev-source-loc.mjs:54 A build-time-only package runs on the dev workstation inside the Vite serve process. The build is not hermetic, and the repo has no build-time inventory or per-entry 'what could this reach' record (searched). Opt-in via ATHENA_INSPECTOR=1 limits exposure but does not replace the inventory.

apps/desktop/scripts/dev-source-loc.mjs:65 The plugin transforms only this repo's own source, not a foreign tree, so the precondition does not hold. Even so, configFile:false and babelrc:false stop Babel from evaluating config programs found in the tree.

apps/desktop/vite.config.ts:69 Nothing in these files unpacks an archive (git grep for unzip/extract found nothing). The only path built from a request is this dev-server film route, bounded by a one-segment regex.
